tagline.id: Rig bench-top untuk proses bioetanol: boiler, reaktor, separator, dan kontrol pemanas.
tagline.en: A bench-top bioethanol rig: boiler, reactor, separator, and heater control.

approach.id: Boiler, pipa reaktor, tangki separator, dan holder desikan disusun di atas base kayu sekitar 58×32 cm. Umpan masuk lewat spuit 120 ml, dan pemanas dikontrol SSR dengan pembacaan suhu termokopel MAX6675 di control box.
approach.en: A boiler, reactor pipes, a separator tank, and a desiccant holder are laid out on a wooden base of about 58×32 cm. Feed goes in through a 120 ml syringe, and the heater is controlled by an SSR with MAX6675 thermocouple readings in the control box.
